notes: Two reverse-spec capability buckets identified — `digital-signing` (large, ~41 methods) and `openregister-bridge` (small, 3 methods). The signing surface is by far the largest spec gap: a SigningController + SigningService + 3 providers (native + ValidSign + factory) + audit + verification — none of which has a matching openspec/specs/ entry. Two in-flight change proposals (`document-signing`, `migrate-signing-to-or-approval-workflow`, `migrate-signing-audit-to-or-audit`) are present in openspec/changes/ but no archived spec exists; recommended next step is `/opsx-reverse-spec docudesk --cluster digital-signing`.
Bucket 2a `metadata-enrichment` (3 methods in `LanguageClassifier.php`) is a *duplicate* of `TextAnalysisService` and likely refactor-candidate rather than missing-REQ — surface for human review.

Two `Controller/TemplatesController.php::preview*` methods were tentatively bucketed to `print-preview` capability with NEEDS-REVIEW because the `print-preview` spec already nominates `PrintController` for these endpoints. Could equally be bucket 2a (template-management preview extension).
Document-register (REQ-DREG-01..07) is a JSON-schema spec with no PHP locus — landed entirely in 3b by design, not as a gap finding.
REQ-SET-08/09 are info.xml/static-config REQs and have no PHP method locus; expected 3b.
Vue-side REQs (REQ-ANON-08/10, REQ-DASH-01/03/05, REQ-CONS-10, PRINT-020..025) landed in 3b — out of PHP scan scope, NOT actual gaps.

Reverse-pass cache had 48,759 removed lines; spot-checks on `correspondence`, `huisstijl`, `consolidateEntities`, `batchExtract` confirmed reasonable signal. No REQ landed in 3a with strong evidence — all unimplemented PHP-locus REQs are either Vue-side, info.xml, or schema-level.
No methods are pre-annotated with `@spec openspec/changes/...` (annotated bucket is 0) — this app is a clean greenfield retrofit target.
Two namespace-word warnings AVOIDED — both 2b clusters (`digital-signing`, `openregister-bridge`) are behavioral labels, not filesystem namespace words.
